statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: templates/website/next.config.ts, templates/website/src/**, templates/website/tests/**. Do not edit forbidden paths: templates/** (except templates/website allowed paths), package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, packages/**.
Keep the repository build and task-specific host checks passing under the frozen environment contract.

review.notes: Approved: file:next.config.ts is a realistic production target for Next image behavior; both oracle files exist in the frozen website template and are production-scoped. Tailwind authority and candidate scope text are accurate, and the guard covers generated and standard test/build lanes.
